In detail

Quarto Miglio is a quieter, largely residential zone bordering the Appia Antica archaeological park, known locally for municipal road-safety projects. Press coverage includes a documented burglary wave and one reported case of an attempted extortion scam targeting a resident, but no evidence of violent crime or organized drug activity. This points to a genuinely calm, low-crime area with only property-crime concerns worth a yellow at night.
